class: 不含PDE或守恒残差的纯数据回归基线
baseline: multi-output ridge regression on the identical features and labels
target_defect: 量化物理约束是否真正贡献于样本效率、外推和守恒，而非为了追求最低训练误差
new_mechanism: small residual MLP mapping (xi,zeta,t,scenario features,R(t)) to (T,C); loss contains supervised MSE only
loss: Ldata = mean[((T_hat-T)/sT)^2 + ((C_hat-C)/sC)^2]; no PDE, boundary or conservation penalty
inputs: same coordinates, scenario parameters and split as PINN/GNN
outputs: derived Q3/Q4 threshold times after dense-grid evaluation
identifiability: none: coefficients/weights are predictive associations relative to synthetic solver output and cannot identify physical parameters
dependencies: scikit-learn; PyTorch only if shared with other candidates
minimum_experiment_matrix: ridge and MLP at 18,36,72 training scenarios
same Q3/Q4 interpolation and extrapolation sets
post-hoc physics audit on independent stencil, never added to training
expected_evidence: fair lower-bound comparison for prediction error, data hunger, extrapolation, threshold safety and physics violations
retention_threshold: may be retained only as a comparison baseline; even if accurate against PDE labels it cannot replace M1-M4 or claim real-world accuracy
fallback: if MLP fails to beat ridge by >=10% C-RMSE across seeds, use ridge alone as pure-ML baseline
claim_limit: 没有独立实验数据时，只能声称复现PDE数值映射的精度，不能声称现实药材烘干精度或泛化
